groups.name: Core
groups.description: Geometry, finite element spaces, variational expressions, assembly and linear algebra form the path from a weak formulation to an algebraic system.

modules.title: Geometry
modules.description: Mesh<Context::MPI> and getConnectivity().compute(d1, d2) describe mesh entities and their incidence relations. Polytope, Geometry::Point, and PolytopeTransformation connect reference elements to physical geometry for integration, field evaluation, mesh extraction, and deformation.
modules.brief: Meshes, geometric transformations, and mapped evaluation.

modules.title: Variational
modules.description: H1 and P1 define finite element spaces, while GridFunction evaluates and interpolates discrete fields. TrialFunction, TestFunction, and Problem express weak forms, boundary conditions, and the algebraic problems used to solve PDEs.
modules.brief: Finite element spaces, fields, and variational problems.

modules.title: Assembly
modules.description: Assembly::Sequential evaluates local integrals and accumulates global matrices and vectors; Assembly::Default selects the configured assembly strategy. BilinearFormAssemblyInput supplies spaces and integrators, and ConstraintMap expands degree-of-freedom constraints when assembling constrained or coupled problems.
modules.brief: Global assembly of discrete operators.

modules.title: Solver
modules.description: CG handles symmetric positive-definite systems, GMRES handles general iterative solves, and SparseLU provides direct sparse factorization. NewtonSolver drives nonlinear solves. These solvers operate on prepared systems or variational problems and provide convergence controls for PDE and optimization calculations.
modules.brief: Solution of linear and nonlinear discrete systems.

modules.title: Quadrature formulae
modules.description: QuadratureFormula selects persistent reference integration rules by geometry and exactness. GaussLegendre, TensorProduct, and the simplex rule families supply points and weights for element integration and reference-basis tabulation.
modules.brief: Module for defining quadrature formulae over reference polytopes.

modules.title: Math
modules.description: SpatialVector<T> and SpatialMatrix<T> support small spatial calculations without heap allocation. Vector<T>, Matrix<T>, and their fixed-size counterparts provide Eigen-compatible algebra; LinearSystem<Operator, Vector> groups system data and constraint elimination. These types support geometric mappings, constitutive calculations, assembly, and linear solves.
modules.brief: Spatial arithmetic, matrix operations, and sparse linear algebra.
modules.representative:
SpatialVector<Real> a{1, 2, 3};
SpatialVector<Real> b{4, 5, 6};
const Real product = dot(a, b);       // 32
const auto normal = a.cross(b);      // {-3, 6, -3}
const Real length = a.norm();        // sqrt(14)

modules.title: Form language
modules.description: Base supplies the common expression-node interface, Traits describes ranges and algebraic properties, and List groups polymorphic nodes. They underpin the typed variational expressions used to compose integrals and operators, and provide extension points for new function and form types.
modules.brief: Typed expressions for constructing variational forms.
modules.representative: auto stiffness = Integral(Grad(u), Grad(v));

modules.title: IO
modules.description: MeshLoader and MeshPrinter import and export meshes; GridFunctionLoader and GridFunctionPrinter transfer discrete fields. Format-specific backends support MFEM, MEDIT, and HDF5 data, while IO::XDMF writes meshes, multiple fields, and time series for visualization.
modules.brief: Reading and writing meshes, fields, and associated data.
modules.representative:
IO::XDMF xdmf("output");
xdmf.grid().setMesh(mesh).add("u", u.getSolution());
xdmf.write();

groups.name: Models
groups.description: Transport, distance construction, regularization, solid mechanics and cardiac models are expressed using the core numerical interfaces.

modules.title: Solid
modules.description: getLogJacobian() computes deformation measures for constitutive laws such as NeoHookean and HolzapfelOgden. InternalVirtualWork assembles residuals and consistent tangents, and stress fields such as CauchyStress<Law> support postprocessing. The module covers finite-strain elasticity and fiber-reinforced material models.
modules.brief: Constitutive laws, kinematics, and solid-mechanics integration.

modules.title: Advection
modules.description: Lagrangian advances scalar fields on unstructured meshes by tracing characteristics and projecting the transported field into a finite element space. It is used to transport level sets and other evolving fields; boundary policies control the treatment of characteristics that reach the mesh boundary.
modules.brief: Transport and advection of fields.

modules.title: Eikonal
modules.description: FMM implements fast marching on simplicial meshes, propagating arrival times from prescribed seed vertices. It provides the underlying distance propagation used by level-set reinitialization and distance-field construction, with a priority queue controlling the order of vertex updates.
modules.brief: Eikonal equations and distance propagation.

modules.title: Distance
modules.description: Distance::Eikonal constructs distance fields through fast marching, while Distance::Poisson and Distance::SignedPoisson provide PDE-based alternatives. These models convert boundary or level-set information into distance approximations for shape optimization, interface processing, and mesh adaptation.
modules.brief: Distance-field computations.

modules.title: Hilbert
modules.description: getTrialFunction() / getTestFunction() solves a regularized extension problem that converts a linear functional into a smooth field over the mesh. It is commonly used to extend boundary shape derivatives into volume descent directions, with a configurable length scale controlling smoothing and boundary conditions constraining the extension.
modules.brief: Hilbert-space formulations and regularization.

modules.title: Adaptation
modules.description: SWIFT::Adapt and SWIFT::Problem fit mesh interfaces to level sets while controlling element distortion. DeformationMap and CellDeformation describe mapped geometry for evaluating deformed cells and fields. These components support moving-interface calculations and body-fitted mesh updates.
modules.brief: Mesh adaptation and deformation operations.

modules.title: Heart
modules.description: CCMLC2014T advances a reduced ventricular model through a cardiac cycle. HolzapfelReducedLaw and CCMLC2014PassiveLaw supply its reduced passive energy and stress response. The module supports cardiac-cycle studies and constitutive parameter calibration before larger three-dimensional simulations.
modules.brief: Cardiac models and their coupled state evolution.
modules.representative: const auto report = model.step(dt);

groups.name: Parallelism and integrations
groups.description: These modules connect Rodin to distributed execution, external solver backends, mesh adaptation and graph partitioning libraries.

modules.title: MPI
modules.description: Context::MPI supplies the distributed execution context, while Mesh<Context::MPI> manages distributed mesh entities and connectivity. Sharder partitions mesh data for transfer between ranks. Distributed finite element spaces, point location, and assembly build on these components for multi-process PDE calculations.
modules.brief: Distributed meshes, finite element spaces, and search operations.
modules.representative: using DistributedMesh = Geometry::Mesh<Context::MPI>;

modules.title: PETSc
modules.description: PETSc::Math::LinearSystem groups PETSc matrix and vector handles, while KSP and SNES expose linear and nonlinear solvers. PETSc-backed variational and assembly specializations connect the same weak-form interfaces to distributed algebra, preconditioning, and solver configuration for larger PDE systems.
modules.brief: PETSc integration module for Rodin.
modules.representative: Solver::KSP(poisson).solve();

modules.title: MMG
modules.description: MMG::Mesh::Build() connects Rodin geometry to MMG. MMG::Adapt performs metric-driven adaptation, MMG::Optimizer improves mesh quality, and noSplit(ref) fits or extracts an isosurface. These workflows support remeshing and interface reconstruction in shape optimization and evolving-geometry simulations.
modules.brief: Mesh adaptation through the MMG integration.
modules.representative:
MMG::Mesh cut = MMG::LevelSetDiscretizer()
  .setLevelSet(0.0)
  .split(interior, { interior, exterior })
  .setBoundaryReference(interface)
  .discretize(phi);

modules.title: Scotch
modules.description: Partitioner builds a graph-based partition of mesh cells using Scotch. The resulting cell assignments feed mesh sharding and distribution, helping divide finite element workloads across MPI ranks while limiting connections between partitions.
modules.brief: Graph partitioning through the Scotch integration.
modules.representative:
Scotch::Partitioner partitioner(mesh);
partitioner.partition(numRanks);

groups.name: Infrastructure
groups.description: Execution contexts, diagnostics, spatial search, type utilities, serialization and numerical test helpers support the numerical modules.

modules.title: Context
modules.description: Local selects local execution, and Context::MPI carries the environment and communicator for distributed execution. Mesh, connectivity, and finite element specializations use these context types to select their data distribution and backend behavior while preserving the same mathematical interfaces.
modules.brief: Execution contexts for local and distributed computation.
modules.representative:
using LocalMesh = Geometry::Mesh<Context::Local>;
auto mesh = LocalMesh::UniformGrid(Geometry::Polytope::Type::Triangle, {8, 8});

modules.title: Alert
modules.description: Alert::Exception and Alert::MemberFunctionException report errors with contextual diagnostics. Alert::Info and Alert::Warning provide nonfatal messages through the same stream interface. These classes communicate invalid inputs, unavailable operations, and solver or mesh-processing status.
modules.brief: Contextual exceptions and diagnostic reporting.
modules.representative: Alert::Info() << "Assembling the system..." << Alert::Raise;

modules.title: Location
modules.description: AABB builds a bounding-volume hierarchy to locate physical coordinates in a mesh and recover the containing cell and reference coordinates. The resulting Geometry::Point can be used for field sampling and evaluation at arbitrary locations. The locator must be rebuilt when the mesh geometry or topology changes.
modules.brief: Spatial indexing and geometric search.
modules.representative:
Location::AABB locator(mesh);
const auto point = locator.locate(physicalCoordinates);

modules.title: Utility
modules.description: ParameterPack and Zip support compile-time type and parameter manipulation. Overloaded combines callable visitors, and OptionalReference represents optional non-owning access. These helpers support generic expressions, type dispatch, and reusable library extensions.
modules.brief: Type utilities and generic programming helpers.
modules.representative:
std::variant<int, Real> value = 2;
const Real result = std::visit(Utility::Overloaded{
  [](int x) { return Real(x); },
  [](Real x) { return x; }
}, value);

modules.title: Serialization
modules.description: Boost.Serialization adapters store arrays, Eigen-compatible dense matrices, flat containers, and optional values. The export registrations cover selected ParametricTransformation instantiations used in MPI shard transfer. Including the relevant adapter headers enables binary archives of supported numerical data and container structures.
modules.brief: Serialization and reconstruction of library objects.
modules.representative: archive << values;

modules.title: Test
modules.description: FDProbe compares assembled tangents with finite differences and returns error diagnostics in FDProbeReport. ExpectedResultTable organizes known input-output cases, and random generators supply test samples. These helpers support numerical regression tests for constitutive laws, geometry, and variational operators.
modules.brief: Helpers for constructing numerical tests.
